assertions.title: Netflix controls update modeled frontier and title-ranking outputs

steps.action: Open /projects/netflix-roi and inspect the interactive chapter
steps.expected: Visible simulator controls for budget, buzz, acclaim, retention, or decay plus downstream outputs
steps.observed: Visible sliders rendered for Budget ($90M), Buzz (66%), Critical acclaim (74%), Retention priority (58%), and Buzz decay intensity (44%), alongside title selector buttons and downstream KPI/output sections.

steps.action: Increase the Budget slider from $90M to $95M
steps.expected: Selected-title details and at least two outputs update visibly
steps.observed: Budget changed to $95M; Predicted adds changed from 1.19M to 1.21M; Retention months changed from 5.2 to 5.3; stress cards updated from 1.19M/5.2 mo to 1.21M/5.3 mo with upside 1.41M and downside 0.95M.

steps.expected: Selected-title detail packet and recommendation outputs update without reload
steps.observed: Selected title switched from Bridgerton (#9, capital intensive, 21% vs top title) to The Residence (#2, scalable, 97% vs top title); payback changed from 5.3 months to 2 months and capital recommendation changed from 'hold or rework concept' to 'greenlight and overweight'.

evidence.network: Local route loaded successfully. Browser captured GET /projects/netflix-roi?routeProbe=loading -> 200 and GET /projects/netflix-roi?routeProbe=error -> 200 during recoverability checks; curl confirmed GET /projects/netflix-roi -> 200.

assertions.title: Netflix route translates analysis into interpretable recommendation language

steps.action: Inspect the live route's committee decision and evidence sections
steps.expected: An interpretable recommendation packet exposing predicted adds, retention months, greenlight score, capital recommendation, and supporting evidence
steps.observed: The route exposed PREDICTED ADDS (1.19M initially, then 1.21M after budget change), RETENTION MONTHS (5.2 then 5.3), GREENLIGHT SCORE (0), capital recommendation ('hold or rework concept' for Bridgerton, then 'greenlight and overweight' for The Residence), expected payback window, selected-rank details, modeled value mix, and an evidence trace packet with recommendation ID, confidence band, primary drivers, and trust boundary language.

steps.action: Validate that recommendation language remains committee-oriented and interpretable
steps.expected: A coherent decision packet with supporting evidence rather than isolated metrics
steps.observed: The route showed 'COMMITTEE DECISION PACKET', 'MODELED COMMITTEE OUTPUT', 'DECISION CONSOLE', and 'ACTIVE COMMITTEE EVIDENCE PACK' sections that tied the selected title, rank, payback, capital lane, recommendation, and evidence trace together in one readable flow.

evidence.network: Live route served over local Next.js runtime; curl confirmed GET /projects/netflix-roi -> 200.

assertions.title: Netflix loading or route failures remain recoverable

steps.expected: Distinct Netflix-specific loading state with visible recovery actions
steps.observed: A Netflix-specific LOADING state rendered with copy 'Recoverability probe active: ranking board, frontier scenario deck, and committee packet are rehydrating...' plus visible recovery actions 'Open live route' and 'Back to projects'.

steps.expected: Distinct Netflix-specific route error state with visible recovery actions
steps.observed: A Netflix-specific ROUTE ERROR state rendered with copy about a controlled failure preserving acquisition-versus-retention framing, plus 'Open live route', 'Back to projects', and diagnostics showing 'message: Recoverability probe triggered with ?routeProbe=error'.

steps.expected: Supported probe URLs should resolve successfully

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed on loading or error probes
evidence.network: Browser request log captured GET /projects/netflix-roi?routeProbe=loading (document) and GET /projects/netflix-roi?routeProbe=error (document); curl also returned HTTP 200 for both probes.

frictions.description: The first browser network-requests check on the live route returned 'No requests captured', so I used explicit probe navigations plus curl status checks to record route-level network evidence.
frictions.resolution: Captured browser request logs while navigating to the supported probe URLs and verified all three target URLs with curl.

summary: Retested 3 Netflix ROI assertions on the production-like runtime: VAL-NETFLIX-002 passed, VAL-NETFLIX-003 passed, and VAL-NETFLIX-005 passed. The live route now exposes working simulator controls and recommendation outputs, and both supported routeProbe URLs render distinct Netflix-specific recoverability states with visible recovery paths.
